about: Window-relative points (physical pixels from the window's top-left corner, as in desktop_windows.py screenshots) where agent_message.py clicks each app's message box and checks it is empty. width is the window's outer width used to pick a layout. text is the area (left, top, right, bottom) that must hold no dark text; it starts just right of where the blinking text cursor sits. frame is the composer's top border (left, right, y, gray value), which must be found in place before a box reads as empty; a layout without one never does. When an app update or a new layout moves these, re-measure as the LLM_Helpers README's agent_message.py section describes and update measured. Each composer layout under apps stays on one line so window sizes compare like table rows. The usage layouts keep named controls and crops on separate lines so an agent can find or update one entry directly.

usage.about: GPT-6.1-Sol mapped these usage controls from live captures on 2026-11-13 and Claude Code's 2026-11-10/11 test commands. Coordinates and crops are physical pixels relative to the outer window. A matching size is necessary, and the user must verify the named screen and panel state on a fresh capture before acting.

codex-usage-half.title: ChatGPT
codex-usage-half.conditions: Right half of a 4K work area with chat list collapsed. Wheel, popup row hovers and Manage usage checked on 2026-11-13. Account-menu route from 2026-11-11. Chat crops measured with a full-width chat and single-line composer. The latest-message control can move as the draft grows. Reset controls from 2026-11-15 (Codex 26.1111.2228.0): open Manage usage, then scroll the settings page to its bottom (scroll -20 at settings-scroll); use-reset is the first available reset's button and moves down a row for each further reset; reset-history fits the History tab's seven rows of 2026-11-15 after the same scroll.

launchAbout: launch is the app's Windows AppUserModelID, which agent_message.py --start opens through explorer.exe with shell:AppsFolder and this ID when no window is open. It is the Store package family name plus the app ID, so it stays the same across app updates; read with PowerShell Get-StartApps on 2026-11-15, when Codex showed as ChatGPT (OpenAI.Codex package).
